source.rankingName: Spotify top artists by monthly listeners
methodologyNotes: Kworb is a third-party source and this is not official Spotify chart data.
Kworb displays Spotify monthly-listener observations and historical peaks; its collection process is not independently verified by Music Roll.
Monthly listeners are a rolling audience signal and may be influenced by playlists, collaborations, seasonality, and current releases.
Top 200 presence is strong mainstream evidence; absence is none_observed, not evidence of underground or emerging status.

rankingImport.musicRollComparison: exact normalized names for reporting only

hardGates: Only an explicitly verified existing Music Roll Spotify ID may become verified_existing.
Duplicate candidate Spotify IDs produce conflicting_identity for every affected record.
Stored external-identifier conflicts produce conflicting_identity; one matching identifier cannot hide a competing identifier.
Multiple exact candidates, punctuation risk, returned-name differences, and short/common names require review.
Rank, listeners, fame, genre, and tier contribute zero identity points.
No second-stage catalog or MusicBrainz evidence is inferred in this pass.
